topic: Data API endpoint requirements and scope
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the required structure for a data API endpoint, specifically concerning location filtering. Initially, [me] proposed an endpoint in standard `data-api` format including `locations[]` (or `facilities[]?`) and suggested adding filters for city and category, though this was deemed potentially unnecessary.

[p1] clarified that the current `data api` does not support additional location parameters. Instead, [p1] advised that users should pass the necessary facility identifiers directly to the endpoint.

Regarding data granularity, [me] plans to add a 'whole period' option in addition to standard day/week/month granularities.
decisions: The data API endpoint will accept required facility IDs passed by the user rather than relying on additional location parameters.
action_items: [p1] will respond to Esben regarding the technical requirements.
